<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnPickVideo" android:layout_width="28dp" android:layout_height="28dp" android:background="@android:color/transparent" android:contentDescription="@string/chat_video" android:padding="4dp" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_slideshow" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" />
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnPickImage" android:layout_width="28dp" android:layout_height="28dp" android:layout_marginStart="6dp" android:background="@android:color/transparent" android:contentDescription="@string/chat_gallery" android:padding="3dp" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_gallery" app:tint="@color/text_secondary" /> </LinearLayout>
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnSendMessage" android:layout_width="38dp" android:layout_height="38dp" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_teal" android:contentDescription="@string/chat_send" android:padding="8dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_chat_send" app:tint="@color/white" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout>
